reason: The primary abstract describes a deep neural network that matches local visual features across image pairs, with adaptive computation and improved memory/computation efficiency for sparse visual matching and latency-sensitive 3D reconstruction. Its task and system are computer vision, not LLM inference/serving or inference-time LLM compression/efficiency. Speed or efficiency claims for a non-LLM vision matcher are outside the stated scope.
title: LightGlue: Local Feature Matching at Light Speed
